---
applyTo: "ui/**/*.py"
---

Read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/accessibility/ACCESSIBILITY.md`, `docs/i18n/TRANSLATING.md`, `docs/architecture/overview.md` and `docs/DOCUMENTATION_POLICY.md`.

Preserve RTL/LTR correctness, keyboard access, accessible names/roles, high-DPI behavior and thread boundaries. Every user-facing string belongs in both language tables. Visible behavior changes require the appropriate English and Hebrew user documentation review.
